title: pleurostachys muelleri f. normalis
intro: Pleurostachys muelleri f. normalis, commonly known as Mueller's grass, is a species of grass in the family Cyperaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Brazilian folk medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported benefits including relief from respiratory issues, digestive problems, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Mueller's grass are attributed to its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relax muscles, reduce swelling, and facilitate the removal of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of Mueller's grass include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
